asciichat_errno.h(3) Library Functions Manual asciichat_errno.h(3)

NAME

asciichat_errno.h - Synchronized per-thread pending error stacks and value snapshots. SET_ERRNO pushes, CLEAR_ERRNO pops. Recovery scopes resolve one attempt's errors. See docs/topics/errno.dox for ownership and capacity contracts.

Detailed Description

Synchronized per-thread pending error stacks and value snapshots. SET_ERRNO pushes, CLEAR_ERRNO pops. Recovery scopes resolve one attempt's errors. See docs/topics/errno.dox for ownership and capacity contracts.

const
  char * asciichat_error_format (const char * message, asciichat_error_t
  code)


Format "message: description (code=N)"; NULL/empty
    message returns only "description (code=N)". Allocation-free and
    thread-local; the returned string survives the next seven calls on this
    thread. Copy it for longer storage. Message text is limited to
    ASCIICHAT_ERRNO_MESSAGE_MAX-1 bytes; the code and meaning are retained. An
    existing matching suffix is not duplicated. This is plain text: use
    SET_ERRNO(code, "%s", formatted), never pass formatted text as the
    printf format. SET_ERRNO already logs code/meaning automatically, so callers
    normally supply only their contextual message.
